intro.heading: Smart Security for Modern Homes
intro.description:
Your home should feel safe — not vulnerable. At Aasra Infotech, we design intelligent residential security systems that protect your family, property, and peace of mind through smart, connected technology.

Our residential solutions combine high-definition surveillance, smart access control, and real-time mobile monitoring into one seamless ecosystem.

What We Deliver

  • Advanced CCTV Surveillance
  • Smart Video Door Phones & Doorbell Cameras
  • Smart Locks & Access Control
  • Intrusion Detection & Motion Sensors
  • Mobile App Integration

sections.title: 1. Advanced CCTV Surveillance
sections.content: We deploy high-resolution surveillance cameras with superior night vision, wide dynamic range, and optimized coverage planning. Each camera is strategically positioned after a site assessment to eliminate blind spots and ensure complete visibility of entry points, parking areas, perimeters, and critical zones. Our systems provide reliable 24/7 recording with secure storage and remote accessibility.

sections.title: 2. Smart Video Door Phones & Doorbell Cameras
sections.content: Our smart door communication systems allow homeowners to visually verify visitors, communicate in real time, and grant or deny access from anywhere. With motion-triggered recording and mobile notifications, you remain aware of all entry activity even when you are not physically present.

sections.title: 3. Smart Locks & Access Control
sections.content: We provide modern, keyless access solutions including PIN-based, biometric, RFID, and mobile-controlled locks. These systems enhance convenience while eliminating risks associated with traditional keys. Access logs and controlled permissions ensure greater security and monitoring of household entry activity.

sections.title: 4. Intrusion Detection & Motion Sensors
sections.content: Our advanced motion detectors and intrusion alarm systems instantly identify unauthorized movement or perimeter breaches. Real-time alerts allow homeowners to respond immediately, reducing the risk of theft, vandalism, or unauthorized access.

sections.title: 5. Mobile App Integration
sections.content: We integrate all security components into a unified mobile platform, enabling live viewing, playback, instant alerts, and remote system control. This ensures you stay connected to your property anytime, from anywhere.
